Five days after COWA questioned the medical and food aid item, the line disappeared while the report still totaled exactly 125 million. Quinestron ng Commission on Audit ang medical and food aid na may halagang 40 million, 42 million, at 40 million sa tatlong unang accomplishment reports. Makalipas ang limang araw, wala na ito sa huling accomplishment report. Pero 125 million pa rin ang kabuuhan ng halaga. Number five. In two years, not one area, not one operation was ever named. Daang-daang area ang iniulat. 500 million ang ginastos. Ngunit wala ni isang lugar, ni isang operasyon. ni isang petsa ang pinangalanan. Number six, the liquidation was late, irregular, and backdated. Sampung buwan huli ang mga resibo. Mahigit isang daan ang may petsang isang taon pagkatapos ng diumanoy bayaran. Walang halaga, walang pangalan, walang lugar at walang petsa. At ang pumirma, ang mismong tumanggap ng pera. Number eight. The 500 million bought protection the Vice President already had.
